description: Default retry strategy — retries up to max_retries with escalation threshold support. Mirrors engine/runtime/retry.py::DefaultRetryStrategy.
instructions: Decide whether to retry based on TaskRecord.max_retries and current attempt count.
If attempt > max_retries and escalate_on_exhaustion is enabled (and escalation threshold reached), set escalate=true.
Otherwise return should_retry=false, escalate=false (task goes to FAILED).
No delay, no input adjustment — simple attempt cap.
